02 / Selected scholarship

Research with a clear physical story.

Thesis, published, and submitted research across battery modelling, photovoltaic parameter estimation, grid-forming control, and renewable mobility.

Thesis researchSupervised by Dr. Md. Zahurul Islam · Professor
01

Coupled Electrochemical–Mechanical Modelling and Sensitivity-Based Optimization of Silicon–Graphite Composite Lithium-Ion Battery Anodes

A physics-based PyBaMM study coupling electrochemical behaviour with stress, fatigue cracking, loss of active material, and SEI growth in silicon–graphite anodes. Global sensitivity and Pareto analyses identify silicon fraction as the dominant design variable and show how higher silicon loading can reduce peak particle stress through a self-dilution mechanism.
